# Generated by tools/build_one_trait_governments.py from CK3 1.20.1.2.
# 15 government switches, run on the ruler. Character scope.
# Do not edit by hand; rerun the tool after a game update.

one_trait_government_feudal_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = {
			title_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = tribal_holding
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		title_province = { set_holding_type = castle_holding }
	}
	change_government = feudal_government
	every_vassal_or_below = {
		limit = {
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			NOT = { has_government = feudal_government }
			capital_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = castle_holding
					has_holding_type = tribal_holding
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		change_government = feudal_government
	}
}

one_trait_government_administrative_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = {
			title_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = tribal_holding
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		title_province = { set_holding_type = castle_holding }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = has_selected_a_government
		value = flag:administrative
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_mechanic = administrative
			NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
		}
		add_character_flag = new_government_is_byz_admin
		tgp_domicile_conversion_when_changing_government_type = {
			NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE = estate
			NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE = administrative_government
		}
		remove_character_flag = new_government_is_byz_admin
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_mechanic = administrative
			NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
		}
		change_government = administrative_government
	}
	change_to_administrative_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
		}
		change_government = administrative_government
	}
	every_vassal_or_below = {
		limit = {
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
			capital_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = castle_holding
					has_holding_type = tribal_holding
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		change_to_administrative_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				government_has_mechanic = administrative
				NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
			}
			add_character_flag = new_government_is_byz_admin
			tgp_domicile_conversion_when_changing_government_type = {
				NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE = estate
				NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE = administrative_government
			}
			remove_character_flag = new_government_is_byz_admin
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
			}
			change_government = administrative_government
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = has_selected_a_government
}

one_trait_government_celestial_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = {
			title_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		title_province = { set_holding_type = castle_holding }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = has_selected_a_government
		value = flag:celestial
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_mechanic = administrative
			NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
		}
		tgp_domicile_conversion_when_changing_government_type = {
			NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE = east_asian_estate
			NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE = celestial_government
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_mechanic = administrative
			NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
		}
		change_government = celestial_government
	}
	change_to_administrative_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
		}
		change_government = celestial_government
	}
	every_vassal_or_below = {
		limit = {
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
			capital_province = {
				OR = {
					has_holding_type = castle_holding
					has_holding_type = tribal_holding
					has_holding_type = nomad_holding
					has_holding_type = herder_holding
				}
			}
		}
		change_to_administrative_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				government_has_mechanic = administrative
				NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
			}
			tgp_domicile_conversion_when_changing_government_type = {
				NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE = east_asian_estate
				NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE = celestial_government
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_government = celestial_government }
			}
			change_government = celestial_government
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = has_selected_a_government
